platforms.name: CKXU 88.3 FM Lethbridge Digital Music Submission Form and Physical Route
platforms.country: Canada / Lethbridge campus-community radio digital web-form and physical submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No fee is stated for the primary station-library submission form. A separate older local mail-out section lists per-release pricing and 2023 deadlines and is excluded from automated use.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official form accepts EPs and LPs only, rejects singles, requires MP3 files through a downloadable Dropbox or Bandcamp link/code, and requests detailed identity, genre, language, release, track-list and content-warning metadata. Form completion, link sharing and the separate stale paid mail-out boundary require owner review.
platforms.notes: The official submission page, 2026 copyright and current Volunteer & Music Director contact responsibilities were verified on 2026-07-10. Official music-submission email links are publicly present but rendered as protected/non-plaintext by the crawler; they were not decoded, contacted or probed.

platforms.country: Canada / Winnipeg campus radio secure-download-link email and physical music submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No public submission fee confirmed; music-library and volunteer-programmer review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official route accepts physical CDs or secure downloadable links through WeTransfer, Dropbox, Google Drive, Bandcamp, Disco or embedded links, rejects individual audio-file email attachments, and accepts EPs only when they contain at least four songs. platforms.name: CFUR 88.7 FM Prince George Digital MP3 and Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: Canada / Prince George campus-community radio digital MP3 and physical music submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No public submission fee confirmed; Music Director review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official route accepts MP3s through Dropbox, Google Drive, attachments, Earshot Distro or Bandcamp codes and also accepts CDs, vinyl and cassettes. platforms.notes: The official Submissions page, named Music Director, public music@cfur.ca business address and station information were verified on 2026-07-10. The address was not contacted or SMTP/MX probed.

platforms.notes: The official 2026 site, Submit Your Music page, digital-form page and physical Music Director address were verified on 2026-07-10. No form was entered or submitted, no terms were accepted and the general station email was not contacted or probed.
